authority: XPath 3.1 F&O 4.7.5 converts the mantissa to an xs:decimal and, where several are numerically equal to it, "the one that is chosen should be one with the smallest possible number of digits" — 2.675, not the double's exact 2.67499999999999982236…; fn:round-half-to-even at 2 digits then gives 2.68. This is the case that separates the specified algorithm from a naive toFixed(2), which answers "2.67".
XPath 3.1 F&O 4.7.5, same rule as the case above: the shortest xs:decimal numerically equal to the double is 1.115, and fn:round-half-to-even at 2 digits resolves the tie towards the even digit.
